name: Player 2D
summary:
Player 2D is a fast, no-nonsense 2D video player for Meta Quest. It runs in Horizon app mode - a comfortable flat window - and is built to play your own video files without friction.

PLAY ANYTHING, OUT OF THE BOX
- H.264, HEVC and AV1 decoding
- MKV, MP4, MOV, TS and WEBM containers
- Up to 4K and 8K, HDR10 with automatic SDR fallback
- Stereo, 5.1 and 7.1 audio, PCM; audio track picker and audio delay

WATCH YOUR OWN FILES
- Media library with thumbnails, grid or list view
- USB and external drives via th
